run_main: run the test evaluation script to evaluate human motion prediction metrics on a test dataset
run_non_overlapping_test: run non-overlapping batch testing on sparse motion data using a diffusion or MLP model
run_overlapping_test: run overlapping sliding window testing on sparse motion data using a diffusion model
run_evaluate_prediction: run evaluation of predicted body motion against ground truth using SMPLH body model metrics
run_BodyModel: run the SMPLH body model forward pass to compute body pose from body parameters
